It’s been a while now, almost seven months, since my husband passed. Everything feels… different. I used to love our little garden, but now, even just the thought of a storm brewing makes my stomach churn. I feel this intense dread, a tightness in my chest, and a sudden cold sweat when the sky darkens. I just freeze up, an overwhelming panic, and I have to go inside and shut all the curtains.

Now, with my eating, it's become quite difficult. Sometimes at work, when the kitchen gets really busy, and I'm looking at all these plates piling up, I suddenly feel like I can’t eat. It’s like a block, a knot in my throat, and I just can't bring myself to swallow anything substantial. I feel nauseous just thinking about certain textures or smells. I still eat, of course, a little here and there, but it’s mostly just tea and toast now. It's not about how I look, really, just… this feeling.
D012-D021_h001.question_a:
"I've been feeling absolutely dreadful lately, doctor. It started subtly, maybe six months ago, but now it's just unbearable. I dread coming to work, especially since our kitchen is in the basement. Every time it even looks like it might rain, or if I hear the wind pick up, I get this immediate, overwhelming panic. My heart starts pounding, I get lightheaded, and I can't even think straight. I just have to get out of there.

I know it sounds silly, but I've even started avoiding certain foods. My husband, bless his soul, he used to love a good steak, but I can't even look at red meat anymore. I get terrified I'll choke, or that it'll make me sick. It’s not about gaining weight, mind you; I’ve always been a bit on the thin side. It’s just this intense, immediate fear of that particular thing, you know? It's like my body just takes over."
D012-D021_h001.question_b: It’s gotten to the point where just looking at food can send me spiraling. I get this awful tightening in my chest, my heart races, and I just *know* it will make me big. It’s been building for about eight months now. I’m so afraid of putting on weight that I’ve started avoiding everything, especially anything that even looks like it might have a lot of calories. I used to love cooking as a kitchen porter, but now, being around all that food, it's torture. My daughter, bless her heart, tries to get me to eat, but I just can't. The thought of ingesting something that will make me gain weight fills me with dread. It’s not that I’m afraid of choking, or getting sick, or any of that, it’s just the weight. I’ve lost so much, and I still feel like I need to lose more. I tell myself it’s for my health, you know, being a widow and on my own now, but honestly, it’s about being thin.

    B. Specific Phobia

    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
